prompt:
Create one polished landscape 5:3 game studio/course splash illustration for a Korean 2D dungeon repair game. The attached image is STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. This is a NEW distinct illustration, not an edit or recreation of its Korean title. EXACT ONLY VISIBLE TEXT: "2DGP" in very large, instantly legible custom carved ivory-stone letters with warm gold bevels, dark teal outline. All four characters must read unmistakably as 2 D G P, horizontally centered and dominating the composition. No other writing, no Korean title, no subtitles, no buttons, no credits.
Art direction: charming premium hand-painted fantasy game illustration, chunky cute proportions, crisp silhouette, rich teal blue shadows and warm brass/gold highlights matching the reference. The letters rest on a small floating dungeon workshop island, stone blocks and brass gears beneath them. A little tired teal-hooded repairman wearing brass goggles and brown tool belt sits against the lower right side of the P, holding a wrench and looking adorably exhausted. At lower left a cheerful small helmeted skeleton helper proudly holds a gear. Characters much smaller than lettering, readable and integrated in the emblem. One small lantern, a repair toolbox, a few pixel-shaped magic sparks subtly evoke 2D game programming without any code/UI. Plain deep midnight teal background with a softly illuminated center and understated grain, large calm negative-space margins. Restrained central emblem, not a busy full dungeon scene. Composition roughly 75% canvas width and 65% height, every letter and character fully inside with generous breathing room. Beautiful intentional splash screen, not a presentation slide. No logos from real organizations, no watermark, no frame. Opaque background.
